summary.intent: Fix a failing vault recovery E2E test in CI, resolve cascading deployment failures (Grafana provisioning, desktop build signing), and perform milestone v1.1 housekeeping including codebase doc updates.
summary.outcome: Fixed vault recovery E2E via a protobuf field number bug and IPNS resolution order fix (PR #369 merged), identified and fixed Tauri signing key wiring in deploy workflow (PR #370), identified Grafana API key expiry for user to rotate, resolved stale debug session, and rewrote all 7 codebase planning docs to reflect current multi-package/crate architecture.

repo: IPNS records encode the CID/path value at protobuf field 1, not field 2 (field 2 is signatureV1) — this caused extractCidFromIpnsRecord to silently fail for all delegated routing responses

resolveIpns tried the IPFS gateway HEAD first (15s timeout per call) before delegated routing — in CI, Kubo cannot resolve mock-published IPNS names, so every call wasted 15s; delegated routing must come first
Vault key blob fetch in recovery.html used direct IPFS gateway /ipns/ path (30s timeout) as primary, which hung CI since the default test timeout was also 30s
Grafana Cloud returns HTTP 404 (not 401/403) on /api/health when a Bearer token is invalid or expired — indistinguishable from a missing endpoint without context
Grafana Cloud has separate key types: data source keys (Loki/Prometheus) vs service account tokens for the Grafana HTTP API — only service account tokens work for dashboard provisioning

Tauri updater signing requires TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD env vars passed explicitly to each tauri-action step — having a pubkey in tauri.conf.json without the private key causes a hard build failure

code.finding: extractCidFromIpnsRecord checked fieldNumber === 2 when it should be === 1; function header comment also said 'field number 2' — both were stale from an earlier protobuf schema assumption
resp.json() consumed the response body, then a subsequent resp.arrayBuffer() call in the same branch would always fail — fixed by putting protobuf parse in an else branch
fetchWithRetry backoff only triggered on thrown errors, not non-OK HTTP responses (429/5xx) — added !resp.ok check to trigger sleep before retry
Introduced shared RECOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS constant (90s) used for both test timeout and assertion timeout — previously they were mismatched (30s test timeout vs 60s assertion timeout)

All three desktop build jobs (macOS, Windows, Linux) were missing TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD env vars on the tauri-action step despite secrets existing in the repo

workflow: For E2E tests involving network services, always run locally with services up before pushing — the test passed in 1s locally vs timing out at 30s in CI
When CI fails with SSH timeout to VPS, verify connectivity from local machine before assuming it's a persistent infra issue — was a transient GitHub Actions network blip
Grafana Cloud service account tokens are managed at /org/serviceaccounts, not in the data source configuration — easy to confuse with Loki/Prometheus API keys
Mapper agents writing docs in parallel need a cleanup pass for markdownlint compliance (bare code fences, emphasis-as-heading) — automated formatting validation catches these before commit

friction: Local E2E test environment required manually starting mock-ipns-routing, API, and web dev server before tests could run
IPNS protobuf field number bug was silent — no error thrown, IPNS resolution just returned null, requiring stepping through the protobuf parsing logic manually
markdownlint hook blocked the codebase docs commit; generated docs had bare code fences and italic footers formatted as emphasis-as-heading across multiple files, requiring multiple fix rounds
CONVENTIONS.md was not covered by the three parallel mapper agents and needed a fourth agent run
PR review thread for encodeURIComponent suggestion required careful reasoning about IPNS name character sets to justify dismissal
open_items: PR #370 (Tauri signing keys wired into deploy-staging.yml) needs merge before next staging deploy will produce signed desktop binaries
